title: PR body claims the right+left chord swallows its release; the code deliberately lets that release click-select
detail: PR body: "ESC during an in-flight click, a right-click that interrupts a drag, and a same-frame right+left chord all swallow that gesture's release so it cannot re-select." Code sets press_swallowed=false and re-anchors, so the plain-release branch click-selects. AC6 interaction map is inaccurate for the chord.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body sentence: ESC and drag-interrupting right-click swallow their release, but the same-frame chord re-anchors the press so its release click-selects from the chord position.
